text:
Samira Patel: Hey — first day! Can't access Google Drive. When I click into Okta it shows 'Activation required' and says contact admin. I did get a Redwood Gmail and can read email but Drive gives a 403. Also 1Password SSO keeps asking for MFA and then errors 'device not allowed'. Anyone know who fixes this?

it-support: Hey Samira! Welcome :) Can you paste the exact Okta error text? Did you click the Okta activation link from the email?

Samira Patel: The message says 'Activation required: Your account is pending admin approval. Contact your org admin.' I don't see an Okta activation email in spam. I can sign into Gmail (samira.patel@redwood.ai) though.

Alex Chen: hi! sometimes Drive/group perms come through SCIM a bit later. I've seen accounts with mail working but drive groups pending. @it-support can you check SCIM provisioning for samira.patel?

it-support: On it. Also, for 1Password, did you click 'Sign in with SSO' or use the emailed invite link?

Samira Patel: used the SSO button. Flow goes to Okta -> back to 1Password -> then a popup: 'MFA required' and when I try to enroll the authenticator it shows 'device not allowed'.

Maya (security): @Samira welcome! We're currently blocking hardware key enrollment from unmanaged devices until device attestation is in place, so YubiKey enrollments are restricted. Are you on a company-managed laptop? If not we can allow TOTP temporarily for onboarding.

it-support: SCIM shows user created but drive-editor group pending. I'll resend the Okta activation and manually add the drive group so you can access Drive right away. @OnboardBot will post status.

OnboardBot: Okta activation link resent to samira.patel@redwood.ai. SCIM sync: 1 failing, 2 success. drive-editor group granted.

Samira Patel: Got the activation email — clicking now. Drive is showing up, I can view the team folders. 1Password still redirected to Okta and then MFA prompt though.

it-support: For 1Password try clearing cookies or use an incognito window and select 'Sign in with SSO' again. If that still fails I'll open a device exception to let you enroll TOTP temporarily.

Samira Patel: Incognito worked — I'm into 1Password. Thanks y'all, huge relief.

Maya (security): Great — we'll set up a short call later this week to get your YubiKey enrolled on a corp device or walk you through the device exception process. Welcome aboard :tada: 

Alex Chen: Welcome Samira! Ping me if you want a quick tour of the Drive layout and where the onboarding docs live.
